critical_code_review_comments: sales_routes.py POST/PUT/DELETE /sales/invoices have NO explicit role enforcement beyond router-level block_employee. Currently this lets data_entry, sales, support, admin all create invoices (intended for data_entry). If invoice creation should be restricted further (e.g., support not allowed), add explicit role check; otherwise add a comment documenting that it's intentionally open to all non-employee roles.

customer_routes.py POST allows roles ['admin','super_admin','sales','support','data_entry'] but PUT/DELETE only admin+data_entry via require_admin_or_data_entry. Inconsistent: a 'sales' user can create a customer they cannot edit/delete. Confirm intended.

lead_routes.py POST allows ['admin','super_admin','sales','data_entry'] but PUT/DELETE rely on check_lead_ownership (sales=own only) without explicit role allowlist - data_entry can update/delete ANY lead through to ownership check. Verify check_lead_ownership accepts data_entry as full access.
Multiple routes still create their own AsyncIOMotorClient (sales_routes.py line 14) instead of importing from utils.dependencies - duplicate connection pools.
